limits: Not tested on real wounds or patients: accuracy on real wounds is unknown.
Synthetic skin is flat, smooth and evenly lit; curved limbs, hair and real tissue are not modelled.
On real photos the stated uncertainty is too narrow: 2 of 7 recorded measurements fell inside their ± 2 sd.
Real test targets: colour sheets from a faulty printer, a black-ink sheet and a coin (3 mm thick, so it reads about 4-5% large).
A card printed at the wrong size biases every area: the app requires a one-time card check (plastic card or ruler) before it records anything.
The healing flag follows a guideline threshold for diabetic foot ulcers and only prompts a clinician review: it does not diagnose, predict an outcome or recommend treatment.
